Make a little time for Itahari.

The practical details for visiting Bahattar Cafe: location, hours, contact, and menu.

Before heading to a café, three things are worth checking: where it is, when it is open, and what is on the menu. Here are the supplied details for Bahattar Cafe in Itahari, Koshi Province, Nepal.

Find the café

The supplied location is Itahari, Koshi Province 56705, Nepal. A street address and exact coordinates have not been supplied. Use the café’s location and directions page to open the supplied Google Maps listing, and confirm the destination before travelling.

Choose your time

The supplied hours are 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Sunday through Thursday, and 8:00 AM to 9:30 PM Friday and Saturday. These hours need owner confirmation before launch. Holiday hours and kitchen cut-off times have not been provided.

Look at the menu first

The complete menu includes espresso drinks, iced coffee, breakfast, refreshments, pizza, burgers, sandwiches, rice, noodles, momo, and snacks. Listed items range from Black Tea at Rs. 85 to Meat Lover pizza at Rs. 795. Add Coil is a separate hookah add-on at Rs. 50, rather than a standalone food or drink.

The reported average spend is Rs. 500–1,000 per person. This is an estimate supplied for the business; your total depends on what you select. Confirm availability and any applicable charges before ordering.

Ask about the details that matter

Parking, Wi-Fi, payment methods, delivery, and reservations are not confirmed. If one of those is essential to your visit, call 982-0347351. See the frequently asked questions for the other supplied information.
